decision_rationale: The local inventory contains ip-adapter_sdxl.safetensors which is SDXL-family compatible with JuggernautXL checkpoint, but the filename indicates it is a generic SDXL IP-Adapter rather than a FaceID-specific adapter. FaceID identity lock capability cannot be assumed from filename alone. Without proven FaceID capability, identity preservation strategy cannot be guaranteed. Review of model documentation and ComfyUI IP-Adapter Plus SDXL FaceID support is required before this adapter can be approved for identity preservation workflows.
